investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Pixpoint Credit Union (digital banking); Platform: on-premises data center DC-A, server range 10.133.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster pixpoi-prod (kubeadm); Ceph cluster providing block storage to a KVM virtual machine platform; one top-of-rack switch pair per rack; network work uses NET- identifiers; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
